picks.headline: UMG Inks Deal With ElevenLabs to Develop AI Music Remix Platform
picks.excerpt: Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs have signed a licensing and joint product deal to build an AI platform where fans can co-create, remix and mash up tracks from artists who opt in. It is ElevenLabs' first major-label agreement, struck without prior litigation.
picks.rationale: ElevenLabs' first major-label deal — struck without litigation — sets the licensing template every AI music tool will now be measured against.

picks.headline: Suno has rebuilt its AI music models from scratch with licensed music
picks.excerpt: Suno's V6 family was retrained on licensed catalogue with Warner Music, BMG and Believe, and ships alongside tools that let users create with and remix music from participating artists.
picks.rationale: A full model rebuild on licensed catalogue plus new remix tooling changes both what Suno can legally output and what producers can actually ship.

picks.headline: Serato's latest update introduces open streaming and 'Lucid Beatgrids' that can adapt to BPM changes
picks.excerpt: Serato 5.0's beta brings analysis that tracks tempo drift in real time, so beatgrids follow live BPM changes instead of assuming a fixed grid - a quiet upgrade to the DJ's core workflow.
picks.rationale: Beatgrids that follow tempo drift instead of assuming a fixed grid rewrites the one assumption every DJ prep workflow was built on.

picks.headline: Audacity 4, free and open-source audio editor, arrives with a revamped UI
picks.excerpt: Audacity reaches v4 with a reworked interface and usability overhaul, alongside a suite of locally-run AI plugins for stem separation and transcription built with Intel. CDM also weighs the Tenacity fork.
picks.rationale: Free, offline stem separation and transcription inside a rebuilt Audacity puts locally-run AI audio tools in reach of anyone with no budget.

picks.headline: Acon Digital Acoustica 8: AI-Enhanced Post-Production
picks.excerpt: Acoustica 8 adds AI-powered restoration, immersive/surround support and a reworked interface, folding machine-learning repair directly into a mastering and post-production editor.
picks.rationale: Machine-learning repair folded straight into a mastering editor removes the round-trip to a separate restoration suite.
